problem: Spiral is grouped with the prescriptive models, but the same paragraph then defines evolutionary models as those that grow with the product. Standard textbooks treat the spiral model as an evolutionary (iterative) model, so a student who learns this line will classify spiral wrongly in the exam.
fix: Write: prescriptive models fix the activities and their order up front, and waterfall and incremental are prescriptive; evolutionary models such as prototyping and spiral let the process grow with the product, and 1.5 covers them.

problem: The text says six umbrella activities 'are commonly listed', but standard lists also include software project tracking and control (and reusability management). A student who answers with only these six can lose marks on a 'name the umbrella activities' question.
fix: Say that commonly listed umbrella activities include software project tracking and control, risk management, quality assurance, technical reviews, measurement, configuration management and documentation, and add a bullet for project tracking and control.

problem: 'done before the product is tested' makes reviews sound like a single stage placed before testing. Reviews of requirements, design, code and test plans happen throughout the project, each one before the work product is used by the next activity.
fix: Write: walkthroughs and inspections of requirements, design, code and test plans, held throughout the project, each review done before the work product moves on to the next activity.

where: Section 4 and Quiz Q7, concurrent model states
problem: The state name 'under review' is used where the usual textbook state list is inactive, awaiting changes, under development, under revision, and done. 'Awaiting' is also left without its object, so 'awaiting' alone is unclear.
fix: Use the standard list: inactive, awaiting changes, under development, under revision and done; then explain that 'under revision' means the work product is being changed after review comments.

problem: The caption says umbrella activities run alongside every framework activity 'shown by the dashed links', but the figure spec draws dashed links only to Communication and Deployment, so the picture contradicts the caption.
fix: Draw a dashed link from the umbrella node to all five activity nodes, or reword the caption to say the dashed links are shown only for the first and last activity to keep the figure readable.
